newsitem.title: USA: Micro Component sees more pressure in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Micro Component sees more pressure in Q2.

text.p: Micro Component Technology Inc, which reported a loss for the September 28 first quarter on sharply lower sales, said results will continue under pressure during the second quarter.

"Although cautiously optimistic, we believe that sales will continue to be adversely affected in the coming quarter and we will continue to explore all areas of cost reduction," said president Roger Gower in a statement.
The company, which supplies semiconductor test-handling equipment, posted a first-quarter loss of $0.15 per share compared to a year-ago profit of $0.24. Sales fell to $2.6 million from $6.9 million.
